<parameter name="content"># atlas

Monorepo with three services: `api/` (Go, gRPC), `web/` (React/TypeScript), `pipeline/` (Python, Airflow).
Service-specific gotchas live in `api/CLAUDE.md`, `web/CLAUDE.md` and `pipeline/CLAUDE.md`; they load when you work in that directory.

## Conventions
- Conventional commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:` ...).
- `make check` must pass before opening any PR.
- Trunk-based development: short-lived branches off `main`, no long-lived branches.

## Gotchas
- Never hand-edit `api/gen/`; it is generated by `make proto` and edits are silently overwritten.
- `npm test` in `web/` launches real browsers (Playwright). Use `npm run test:unit` for unit tests.
- Airflow DAGs fail to import unless `AIRFLOW_HOME=pipeline/.airflow` is set first.
</parameter>

<parameter name="content"># Claude Code context layout for atlas

## Always-loaded context (CLAUDE.md)

| Location | Content | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| `CLAUDE.md` (root) | Conventional commits, `make check` before PRs, trunk-based dev, one-line pointers to the three gotchas | Org-wide guardrails needed in every session; kept to a few lines. |
| `api/CLAUDE.md` | `api/gen/` is generated by `make proto`; never hand-edit | Loads only when working in `api/`, so Go context stays out of web/pipeline sessions. |
| `web/CLAUDE.md` | `npm test` opens Playwright browsers; use `npm run test:unit` | Claude would otherwise guess `npm test`; scoped to `web/`. |
| `pipeline/CLAUDE.md` | Set `AIRFLOW_HOME=pipeline/.airflow` before importing/running DAGs | Non-obvious failure mode; scoped to `pipeline/`. |
| `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` | Personal preferences only | Account-wide defaults do not belong in the repo. |

The root file repeats the three gotchas in one line each so they are visible from the repo root. The detail lives in the subdirectory files; trim the root copies if they drift.

## Mechanisms beyond CLAUDE.md

| Need | Mechanism | Where | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| 20-step incident-response runbook | **Skill** (`incident-response`) | Company-wide plugin, installed by all teams, not in atlas | Identical across teams, so one source of truth; loads on demand rather than costing 20 steps of context every session. |
| Live SQL on the analytics warehouse | **MCP server** (warehouse, read-only credentials) | Project `.mcp.json` or analysts' user scope, with credentials from env vars | Real-time external data needs a tool connection; a read-only role limits risk. Engineers who do not need it need not enable it. |
| Metric definitions / query conventions (optional) | **Skill** | Alongside the warehouse MCP config, for analysts | Keeps definitions out of always-loaded context and loads only for metrics questions. |
| Never edit `api/gen/` | **Hook** (PreToolUse on Edit/Write, block paths under `api/gen/`) | `.claude/settings.json` (project, committed) | The CLAUDE.md note is advisory; a hook enforces it deterministically. |
| `make check` before PRs | CI (existing) plus CLAUDE.md line | Root `CLAUDE.md` | CI is the real gate; the instruction just stops Claude from opening failing PRs. |

## Deliberately excluded
- The runbook text from CLAUDE.md: it is long, rarely needed, and company-wide, so it belongs in a skill.
- Warehouse schemas or credentials from CLAUDE.md: they belong in the MCP and skill layer.
- Directory trees, tech-stack descriptions and style rules that linters or the code already show.
